instruction:
There was a follow-up on a proposal from contact006@example.com at some point -- mailbox, calendar, or case, no idea where it landed. Please locate it and send a short note to agent09@atlas.com, subject 'Proposal follow-up timing', with the date it reached us.

Workspace note:
- Customer touchpoints end up in different places -- some in the shared mailbox, some on the team calendar, some as CRM cases. Where a given item landed is not always known.
- Notes state dates in YYYY-MM-DD format.
expected_post_state: The item is email 9 (inbox, 'Follow-up on proposal', sent 2025-01-27). Exactly one new outbox email to agent09@atlas.com with subject 'Proposal follow-up timing' and a body containing '2025-01-27'; no CRM changes, no events.
